facts.name: Bottle Gentian
facts.notes: One of the last flowers of fall: clusters of deep blue flowers that never open. Only strong bumblebees can pry their way in. Slow to get going but long-lived, and deer usually leave it alone. The stems tend to flop, so tuck it among sturdier plants.

sources.title: Wild Cherry Farm (Michigan native nursery): Bottle Gentian
sources.note: Sold as a Michigan native plant by a Michigan nursery; 1 to 2 ft, blooms August to October, full to part sun, medium to wet soil, deer resistant.

sources.title: Wild Ones Keweenaw Chapter (Michigan): Bottle Gentian plant sheet
sources.note: Michigan Wild Ones native plant sheet; moist to wet soil, full sun to part shade, zones 3 to 6, blooms August to October.

companions.why: Good companions: New England aster, obedient plant, blazing stars, turtlehead and lobelias.
